subject: Implement error handling system with fuzzy matching
description:
Create `src/mamba_mcp_sap_hana/errors.py` with structured error codes, factory function, and Levenshtein distance fuzzy matching.

Must implement:
- `ErrorCode` string constants: `SCHEMA_NOT_FOUND`, `TABLE_NOT_FOUND`, `COLUMN_NOT_FOUND`, `INVALID_SQL`, `WRITE_OPERATION_DENIED`, `QUERY_TIMEOUT`, `CONNECTION_ERROR`, `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `PARAMETER_ERROR`, `PATH_NOT_FOUND`, `VIEW_NOT_FOUND`, `PROCEDURE_NOT_FOUND`
- `ToolError` Pydantic model with fields: code, message, suggestion, context, tool_name, input_received
- `create_tool_error(code, message, ...)` factory function
- Levenshtein distance implementation for fuzzy name matching
- `suggest_similar(name, candidates, max_suggestions=3)` function
- Default suggestions map: each error code has a helpful fallback suggestion text

Reference: mamba-mcp-postgres `errors.py` for pattern.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] All 12 `ErrorCode` constants defined
- [ ] `create_tool_error` returns structured `ToolError` model with all fields
- [ ] Levenshtein fuzzy matching returns closest matches from candidate list
- [ ] `suggest_similar` returns top-N closest names by edit distance
- [ ] Default suggestions map provides fallback for each error code

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Empty candidate list: `suggest_similar` returns empty list
- [ ] Exact match in candidates: returns it first
- [ ] All candidates have high edit distance: returns empty (threshold-based)

_Error Handling:_
- [ ] `create_tool_error` handles `None` optional fields gracefully

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: Each error code resolves to expected string
• Unit: `create_tool_error` produces correct ToolError model
• Unit: Levenshtein distance calculation for known pairs
• Unit: `suggest_similar` returns correct top-N matches
• Unit: Default suggestions map has entry for each ErrorCode

Source: internal/specs/mamba-mcp-hana-SPEC.md Section 5.7
